newsitem.title: USA: Rocky Mountain Internet sees Q1 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Rocky Mountain Internet sees Q1 shr loss.

text.p: Rocky Mountain Internet Inc said early Tuesday that it expects to post a net loss of $890,000, or $0.18 per share, in the first quarter, compared to $263,300, or $0.08 cents per share for the same period in 1996.
Rocky Mountain said preliminary results also show that total revenue increased to $1.4 million in the first quarter as compared to $569,000 in the prior year's first quarter.
Service-based revenue for the first quarter increased to $1.3 million from $500,000 in the same period one year ago, it said.
Rocky Mountain Internet provides turnkey Internet solutions, including Internet access, Web development and hosting and colocation services.
